question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 3.
solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 1'** i.e. **'Strong'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate option to fill in blank number 3 in the sentence is option 1)** 'strong'.**
 
• In this context,** 'strong' **refers to the older man's ability to keep up with the young man and the flock of sheep, despite his weatherworn appearance.
 
• It is an adjective that describes someone who is physically powerful, in good health, or able to withstand adverse conditions.

Therefore, the **correct sentence** is: * 'A young man walks toward me with a stick slung across his back and a flock of sheep at his feet, which carry him down the path like a crowd of rowdy children. An older man follows, weatherworn but still **strong**, a rifle over his left shoulder. He clicks his tongue to (4) _____ the flock. Behind him are two women on horses; I guess (5) ______ are his wife and daughter.'*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Here are the explanations for all the options:
 
 
• **'Sick' **is an adjective that describes someone suffering from ill health. In this context, it would contradict the action of the man following the flock with a rifle on his shoulder.
 
• **'Thin'** is an adjective that describes someone as having little flesh or fat on their body. While it could potentially fit in the context, it doesn't tell us anything about the older man's capabilities or stamina.
 
• **'Slow'** is an adjective that describes someone or something moving or operating at a speed that is less than usual, desired, or expected. In this context, it would not align well with the action of the older man following the young man and the flock.
